on:
  push:

    branches: [ main ]

  validate-and-compile:

      - name: Checkout code

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Verify Leaderboard Scores
        run: python vapor/leaderboards/verify_scores.py

      - name: Validate Achievements Registry
        run: python vapor/achievements/validation.py

      - name: Compile Kat Index
        run: python kats/compile_index.py

      - name: Ensure Index is Up to Date
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code kats/index.json || (echo "Error: kats/index.json is out of date. Please run 'python kats/compile_index.py' locally and commit the changes." && exit 1)
"
